mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 76 degrees under clear skies at Harriet Park. We have a Waning Gibbous moon and the ISS will be visible for 4 minutes starting at 4:17 AM, rising near Verona High School and heading toward Fitchburg. Tonight will drop to a low of 70 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

City updates include floor replacements at the Verona Senior Center starting September 1 with various program closures, and a reminder that water service was temporarily affected near Todd Street due to a water main break.
There is plenty to do tomorrow including trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and The Bogey Factory, plus the Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park and yoga at Insight Wellness.
In a report from August 30, officers responded to a window smashing incident on North Edge Trail where an arrest warrant was issued for the suspect.
The Culver's flavor of the day was Turtle Dove. The restaurant is now closed for the night, but you can head back tomorrow for Chocolate Heath Crunch when they open at 10:00 AM.
